blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Borongan City and Guiuan in Eastern Samar are expected to record a heat index of up to 42 degrees Celsius, classified as “danger,” on Nov. 15, as high temperatures persist in several areas of Eastern Visayas, the state weather bureau said. Tacloban City and Catarman in Northern Samar are expected to record a heat index of 41°C, classified as “extreme caution,” while Catbalogan City in Samar is forecast to reach 40°C. Other areas in the region are also expected to experience high heat levels, with Maasin City in Southern Leyte reaching 39°C and VSU-Baybay in Leyte recording 38°C. […]...
